stages.title: Initial Investigation
stages.description: Aarav examines the study and begins questioning Anaya Kapoor, Kabir Malhotra and Dr. Nisha Verma. Only background facts and the evidence found at the scene are available.

stages.title: Scene and Forensic Review
stages.description: The chessboard, the coffee cups and the note have been examined. The phone recording, building footage, medical examiner's findings, red thread, photograph, Project Echo file and unsent message become obtainable.

stages.title: Suspect Evidence
stages.description: Every suspect has been interviewed and the forensic picture is in place. Evidence tied to individual suspects becomes obtainable.

stages.title: Suspect Confrontation
stages.description: Evidence against each suspect is in hand: Kabir's fingerprints, Anaya's knowledge of the apartment and Dr. Verma's evening visit. The suspects can now be confronted, and what each is concealing becomes available to their dialogue.

stages.title: Final Investigation
stages.description: The unsent message, the photograph, the red thread and Dr. Verma's unexplained knowledge are all in hand. The facts about the Puppeteer and the larger mystery become available.
